    /* ==========================================================================

       [data-settings-ui=\"appearance\"]

       INVARIANT:
       Tenant/module/preset theme CSS MUST NOT leak structural effects

       into plain text elements (p, span, label, h*) inside the Settings panel.
       Input/button borders are NOT affected ΓÇö they use Tailwind classes directly.
       ========================================================================== */

    /* Reset structural effects on TEXT elements only ΓÇö NOT on inputs/buttons */
